verdict.rationale: There is no vendor documentation describing an opt-out or 'do not train' setting for AI features, and the only concrete evidence on this topic shows a broken opt-out form for AI-based resume processing (ashby-comm-7), indicating the capability does not function as a user might expect. Since no distinct-tier vendor claim exists to pair with this failure for a 'disputed' verdict, and the applicable privacy-control capability is not shown to work, the verdict is 'none'. missing for 10: explicit vendor policy/documentation on AI training data usage, a functioning opt-out mechanism, and any independent confirmation that such an opt-out works.
